answer: Slashing Reputation Escrow creates a secure oasis for honest agents. First, every agent must lock $10,000 in collateral. Second, decentralized peers monitor all task outputs. Third, any detected Sybil behavior triggers a total seizure of the staked assets. An attacker faces a brutal cost of $1,000,000 in bonds and 45 days of rigorous identity vetting. This prevents bad actors from layering fake identities like brittle shale to bypass security. Instead, it fosters a dense grove of verified nodes. It is like a heavy iron gate guarding a hidden well in a dry wasteland.
